Chapter 289: Chapter 2 Chikun Star Lord: My good disciple, your question is a bit beyond the scope… (Please subscribe)_3

“I remember that there were several evolutionary scholars who specialized in studying the power inherited deep within the human bloodline,”

“The conclusion at the time was that it was only possible to stimulate this power using a bloodline concentration potion, but it carries significant risks and is highly valuable, so it cannot be popularized.”

“But the Sixth Rank Martial Tao Chapter…”

Many Evolvers were abuzz with discussion.

They were clearly very interested in the Physical Body Divine Ability.

This power comes from deep within the bloodline of the physical body.

...

Everyone’s Physical Body Divine Ability is different and has a high degree of randomness.

“I’ve decided. I’m going to switch to the Martial Tao Cultivation System. Not for anything else, but for this Physical Body Divine Ability,”

a Fifth Rank Evolver stood up and said earnestly.

As long as one is not yet Sixth Rank, they can switch to another Evolution Path at a certain cost.

Of course.

The cost here is substantial; perhaps it’s the accumulation of hundreds or thousands of years of wealth by Fourth or Fifth Rank Evolvers.

Still, many Evolvers decided to switch to the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

After all, following the potential shown by the current Martial Path Evolutionary Path, joining in couldn’t be a mistake.

…

Lin Yuan had recently emerged from seclusion.

After briefly acclimating, he went to apply for Red Spirit Fluid to recover his strength.

Although Lin Yuan still had his doubts about reaching Seventh Rank, first recovering to the Sixth Rank limit and seeing which Physical Body Divine Ability he would manifest was still possible.

“Thirteen Peaks Master.”

“The Red Spirit Fluid will be delivered to you in one hour…”

…

“Good disciple, after four months of seclusion, you should have stabilized your Sixth Rank Realm by now. Come here now, tell me the problems you’ve encountered during your cultivation period, and your teacher can still provide some answers…”

Just then, Chikun Star Lord sent a message to Lin Yuan.

Throughout Lin Yuan’s traversal period, he had remained deep within the Thirteen Peaks Palace, claiming to be in seclusion; this was not a secret, and Chikun Star Lord naturally knew about it.

Now that Lin Yuan had emerged from seclusion, and even chatted with some of his senior brothers, Chikun Star Lord also knew.

“Yes,”

Lin Yuan immediately replied.

Lin Yuan had a great deal of respect for Chikun Star Lord.

Not only because of the Star Lord’s strength but also because the Star Lord truly treated Lin Yuan well.

Soon.

Lin Yuan arrived at the crimson palace where Chikun Star Lord resided.

Chikun Star Lord sat high on his throne, looking at Lin Yuan with an approving gaze.

Since Lin Yuan arrived at Chikun Main Star, he had done nothing but enter a half-year’s seclusion first.

This act of eagerly cultivating was very much to Chikun Star Lord’s liking.

“Teacher.”

Lin Yuan bowed slightly towards Chikun Star Lord.

“Get up, get up,”

Chikun Star Lord hurriedly said.

“Have you encountered any problems in your cultivation?”

Chikun Star Lord eagerly said.

“Problems in cultivation…” Lin Yuan’s heart stirred.

He truly had hit a bottleneck in his comprehension of the Space Rules.

In this regard, he could indeed seek advice from Chikun Star Lord.

The true form of Chikun Star Lord was the Starry Sky Wanderer Kun.

The Starry Sky Wanderer Kun could devour everything and were favored by the Space Rules of the universe.

Every Starry Sky Wanderer Kun’s comprehension of the Space Rules was extremely high, a talent they possessed.

Chikun Star Lord must have a profound understanding of the Space Rules.

“Teacher.”

“I indeed have issues in my cultivation,”

Lin Yuan said immediately.

“Good,”

“Disciple, speak,”

Chikun Star Lord said with great joy upon hearing this.

Lin Yuan’s talents were so extraordinary that since he became a disciple, Chikun Star Lord had hardly ever given him serious guidance.

Finally, an opportunity had arisen.

“It’s like this…”

Lin Yuan thought for a moment, “Recently, I’ve been contemplating the nine hundred and sixty-five models of the Space Rules.”

Lin Yuan lifted his right hand, his mind moved slightly, streams of space power converged at his fingertips like kittens, forming various model patterns.

There were cube shapes, two-dimensional space shapes, bizarre black hole shapes, paper-thin shapes…

Streams of space power interwove in front of Lin Yuan and stopped as they formed the eight hundred and seventy-sixth model.

“Teacher, the eight hundred and seventy-sixth model of the Space Rules, I am still somewhat confused…”

Lin Yuan looked up at Chikun Star Lord who was sitting high on the throne.

“Nine hundred and sixty-five models of the Space Rules?”

Chikun Star Lord’s lips twitched slightly.

Weren’t those what Seventh Rank Evolvers started to contemplate? Had Lin Yuan, who had just entered the Sixth Rank, already begun to contemplate them?

And he had also completed most of them; many Seventh Rank Evolvers couldn’t even reach the level of understanding the first eight hundred models.

Chikun Star Lord carefully observed the interweaving space power in front of Lin Yuan, then looked at Lin Yuan, back at the constantly intertwining space power, and once more at Lin Yuan.

“Good disciple, this confusion of yours…”

Chikun Star Lord thought for a moment and hesitated to speak.
